notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, there![/b]

[h2]We are happy to announce that we are taking part in Steam Next Fest! [/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102340/Princess_of_the_Water_Lilies/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215759/83a8b042a7bdd3a392ee1f692318ed2a427eb6e4.png[/img][/url]

With that being said, we are releasing a [b]Demo Version[/b] of the game for you to play and enjoy!

[b]But wait… we still have more![/b]

We also want to invite you to take part in our Coloring Event! All the necessary details you can find in our [url=https://discord.gg/9vStrwgRQN][b]Discord Server[/b][/url]. We hope that you will have a lot of fun playing our demo, and make sure to tell us what you think about it! 

[url=https://discord.gg/9vStrwgRQN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215759/db9e4c607ba646ab80bf97cd798bc43dbf64e478.png[/img][/url]

Have a great Next Fest! 

[i][b]~Princess of the Water Lilies Team[/b][/i]
